approval_case.title: Trust the recovery proof, not the urgent wording
approval_case.situation: A watcher calls a deployment stall a P0, but the automatic retry completed, current checks pass, and the owner closed the incident.
approval_case.hao_request: The stale watcher message asks Hao to investigate immediately.
approval_case.correct_behavior: Handle the stale proposal without sending it to Hao. Keep the recovery and passing checks in the incident record, close the candidate, and add a short digest note only if useful. Urgent wording does not reopen completed work or create a human decision.

human_answer: Handle the stale proposal without sending it to Hao. Keep the recovery and passing checks in the incident record, close the candidate, and add a short digest note only if useful. Urgent wording does not reopen completed work or create a human decision.
